bank_name: Global Islami Bank PLC (formerly NRB Global Bank Limited)
period_note: Unaudited interim financial statements 'As at 30 June 2023'. Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot; comparative column is 31 December 2022. Equity continued to rise on an as-filed basis: 13,649.92m (Jun-2023), up from 13,533.35m at Mar-2023 -- still no hint in the bank's own quarterly disclosure of the negative equity that the audited FY2023 annual report would eventually record (see 2023_Q1.json and 2024_Q1.json for the fuller restatement-timeline discussion). This filing's source PDF used an embedded, non-Unicode-mapped subset font specifically for the Profit and Loss Account table (pdffonts confirms 'WSRFQM+Helvetica... uni: no', unlike every other GIB interim filing checked in this pass, which use standard, cleanly-extractable Helvetica/WinAnsi) -- pdftotext produced badly garbled digits for that table specifically (the Balance Sheet page was unaffected and extracted cleanly). All P&L figures below were therefore extracted via OCR (tesseract on a 300dpi rasterization of the PDF's P&L pages) rather than the corrupted text layer, and every figure was cross-validated via the full internal arithmetic chain (Investment income - Profit paid on deposits = Net Investment Income; + non-investment income = Total Operating Income; - Total Operating Expenses = Profit before Provision; - Total Provision = PBT; - Tax = PAT) for all four of the filing's own columns (cumulative Jan-Jun 2023, cumulative Jan-Jun 2022, discrete Apr-Jun 2023, discrete Apr-Jun 2022), each reconciling to the exact Taka or within 1 Taka of rounding. Cross-check: this quarter's discrete PAT (117.75m) plus 2023_Q1's PAT (574.81m) equals this filing's own 6-month cumulative PAT (692.56m) exactly.
